contracts.source: Rockwell Automation press release: Rockwell Automation Joins Anthropic's Project Glasswing to (09-15-2026)
contracts.signal: Rockwell Automation joined Anthropic's Project Glasswing and, through controlled access to Claude Mythos 5, its security teams are exploring ways to accelerate the discovery, validation, prioritization and remediation of vulnerabilities across the software and connected systems manufacturers rely on. Per the release, Anthropic launched Project Glasswing in April 2026 to give approved organizations access to Claude Mythos Preview for defensive cybersecurity work; Anthropic says it began with roughly 50 partners and has expanded to approximately 150 additional organizations across more than 15 countries. Tony Baker, vice president and Chief Product Security Officer: Rockwell is 'applying advanced AI capabilities in a controlled, defensive way to help identify and address vulnerabilities faster'; participation is expected to support more resilient products and faster vulnerability handling. No value or term is stated.
contracts.type: AI model access (Project Glasswing defensive-cybersecurity program)
